rules.name: Threshold Margin Spike
rules.description: Attack similarity is comfortably above the verification threshold.

rules.name: Borderline Repeated Attempts
rules.description: Attack similarity lands near the threshold, which needs repeated-attempt monitoring.

rules.name: High Query Black-box Pattern
rules.description: High query count suggests black-box probing such as Square/ZOO.

rules.name: Strong Defense Bypass
rules.description: A strong defense such as smoothing still accepts the adversarial attempt.

rules.name: Multi-target Source
rules.description: The same source identity appears against multiple target identities.

rules.name: High-risk Target Account
rules.description: The same target identity receives many accepted attack attempts.

rules.name: Look-alike Hard Negative
rules.description: The clean source-target similarity is already high for a negative pair.

rules.name: Low-norm Successful Attack
rules.description: The attack succeeds with a small perturbation norm.
